Also try the target fields declared unique (autonumber included) before reporting reference_not_found, keeping the ambiguity rule. Measured on main e41642dd: candidate list unchanged. The spec tells an author whose action has params to move the confirm question from confirmText onto description, where the same double-brace record hole now prints raw (measured through the runner from both doors).
